scenes.line1: How does pytest keep tests clean?
scenes.say: Ever wonder how pytest keeps your test files clean and organized? And what exactly are fixtures doing for you?

rows.b: Named with test at the start

scenes.say: Pytest finds any function that starts with the word test. Fixtures handle setup or teardown, so you don't repeat yourself. Assertions check if your code does what you expect.
Here, the fixture named db connects to your database. Any test that needs it just asks for db as an argument. No need to rewrite your setup code.

scenes.question: How do fixtures help tests stay DRY?
scenes.wrong: They only run once per file.
scenes.right: They provide reusable setup and teardown, so you don't repeat code in each test.
scenes.say: Here's a common trap: thinking fixtures only run once per file. Actually, they make setup reusable, keeping your tests dry and easy to maintain.
